A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CAF-7M/DoubleCast study. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–F support reliable comparison, with no material reading gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original forecasting experiments on CAF-7M, CGTSF and GIFT-Eval, alongside context controls, scaling studies and verification analyses (Tables 2–3, Figure 4, Appendix F).

after.justification: v3 retains these original forecasting experiments and supplementary analyses, including numerical outcomes and qualitative forecast examples.

M1.justification: The context generation and verification pipeline and DoubleCast's Chronos backbone, Qwen3-14B text encoder and DualT5 cross-attention remain unchanged (Section 3; Appendices A–C).

E1.justification: Both versions use the same CAF-7M sources, CGTSF datasets (PTF, LEU and MSPG) and GIFT-Eval tasks. Appendix F.4 retains the same 40 qualitative examples.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged within corresponding experiments: Chronos, Time-LLM, ChatTime and Direct Prompt variants, plus AutoArima and Migas-1.0 on GIFT-Eval (Tables 2–3; Figures 3–4 and 23).

E3.justification: Splits, sample sizes, context controls, forecasting horizons, metrics and training budgets are unchanged (Appendices A, C and E). The corrected dates on existing example plots do not establish a protocol change.

E4.justification: Context removal/swapping controls, data-scaling studies and verification/filtering analyses are retained. Appendix F.4 redisplays the same helpful and harmful context cases without adding or removing analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions retain seed 42, standard-error reporting across windows and 25 independently generated forecasts per instance for Direct Prompt. The qualitative plots preserve their uncertainty bands despite changed styling.

E6.justification: Numerical results are unchanged; for example, Table 2 retains DoubleCast's ALL CRPS of 0.231 ± 0.001 and win rate of 0.71. Matching the redrawn appendix plots confirms unchanged forecasts, future observations and uncertainty bands; their calendar-axis corrections concern presentation.

T1.justification: The context-usefulness definition, fusion and attention equations, and metric formulations remain unchanged (Equations 1–19). No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about context quality, CAF-7M's scale and verification, context utilization and simulated-to-real transfer.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and limitations concerning verifier bias, synthetic-context diversity and temporal grounding remain unchanged. The qualitative examples retain identical context narratives and helpful/harmful classifications.

D1.justification: The front-page dataset link and introduction footnote now specify an HTTPS address with the dataset-specific route, replacing the earlier scheme-less address without that route. This improves access instructions; implementation details, hyperparameters and code links are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix D and the reference list retain the same cited works, comparisons with prior research and novelty positioning.

P1.justification: Textual edits are limited to the displayed dataset address and arXiv version/date line. The substantive prose, terminology, section order and qualitative context narratives are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 35–54 receive corrected calendar axes, revised tick spacing, colors, line weights and legends, and more compact proportions that move some figures between pages. These refine existing displays while retaining their paired panels and captions; other figures and tables are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 replaces misleading 1970-based axes in Appendix F.4 with calendar dates consistent with the examples' contexts and corrects the dataset-access pointer. Smaller plot typography limits readability somewhat, but these corrections provide a limited net improvement in interpretability and access documentation. Scientific methods, evidence and conclusions remain unchanged.
